summary:
The user selected immediate baseline-relative review, one primary progress record and complete bounded delegation. Keep current source, acceptance scope, blocker, owner and next action in the existing primary issue. Dependents retain their own full promise, Status and acceptance but link to changing prerequisite detail. Preserve historical outcomes and durable evidence. Review the known conditional sequence once, including collection and retirement, with separate original clocks, first-failure/Unknown stops and no automatic retry. Standing isolated verification and bounded read-only diagnostics do not acquire another permission gate. Keep one owner through publication and actual consumer adoption.

The optional existing evidence-manifest helper adds verify-delta without replacing v1. It reports source identities, original runs/limits, artifacts, reported acceptance and gaps. Caller-selected baseline/receipt SHA pins allow unchanged historical byte proofs to be reused while changed payloads are bounded, regular, non-link, stable reads. Inheritance establishes neither current mutable-path bytes nor Git correspondence. Original failures and clock/limit types remain immutable; later observations do not replace them. Artifact verification leaves actual process/writer/cgroup/namespace/cleanup settlement and native acceptance Unknown. Manifests and receipts grant no authority or readiness and are not mandatory lifecycle records.

The issue observer uses fixed github.com comment GETs, a cooperative same-custody/request lock, an original-request-bound successful cursor and one finite window. It emits change (including edits), failure or deadline without tick reports, starts no jobs and posts no messages. Partial reads preserve the last complete cursor; query and cleanup reserve precede reader launch. Cancellation/setup failures clean the owned reader before releasing the lock; direct-child reaping is not escaped-descendant settlement or hard containment. This source does not activate the separately qualified installed observe-operation route.

Independent review held the first tooling candidate for interrupted-reader custody, cross-original cursor adoption and Python bool/int/float equality rewriting original records. The same owner repaired them and qualified the changed source through the retained v1 fixture plus20 causal controls in one bounded isolated run. Both existing policy trigger filters include the new sources/tests/doc, and the existing fixture invokes the controls; no extra workflow was created. At capture source review passed; protected delivery and first real consumer adoption still required their own observations. Reuse unchanged evidence without inheriting earlier CI or native acceptance. Measure coordinator interventions per run, repeated evidence reads and source-ready-to-first-native latency using actual coverage. Local reads/reuse are measured separately from reported operation metrics; missing inputs remain Unknown and token savings are unmeasured.
title: Reuse accepted byte proofs and bound coordination attention
